entities.summary: Gospodar Jevrem Teodorović Obrenović, Grand Prince of Šabac was a Serbian politician and revolutionary who served as Prime Minister of Serbia from 1821 to 1826. He was the younger brother of Prince Miloš Obrenović I of Serbia, the founder of the Obrenović dynasty.
